title: Hurricane Maria
description:
Personnel from the 156 Medical Group at Muniz Air National Guard Base, Puerto Rico, participating in a "Medical Knock-Out" designed to make sure the airmen of the Puerto Rico Air National Guard are in good health and qualified to continue with relief efforts in the aftermath of Hurricane Maria, Oct. 14, 2017.
Interview with Master Sgt. Vicente Rosa, superintendent. 
Hurricane Maria formed in the Atlantic Ocean and affected islands in the Caribbean Sea, including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. U.S. Military assets supported FEMA as well as state and local authorities in rescue and relief efforts. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Tayor Harrison)
keywords: ANG, Puerto Rico Air National Guard, Hurricane Maria, VIPR, 156 Medical Group, NGB, Puerto Rico
